comments.new: Selector4 body119: first PEB/Ldr image header rolling checksum followed by nonwritable/nonempty raw-size section processing. Header = 511 little-endian QWORDs offsets0..FF0 then SEVEN bytes FF8..FFE (not FFF), low32 reported. multiplier C83B11B59C77032B, initial seed22EC23BABD3A5801. Report37: +0 zeroextended checksum,+8 processed section count,+16..36 zero. Native ABI and low-ESP guards authoritative; stack aliases and full flattened helper encodings remain under review.
First InLoadOrder entry+30 = image DllBase; decompiler incorrectly casts entry to PEB_LDR_DATA. This is not an all-modules walk.
Tail starts at image+FF8. Native subsequent loads end at FFE, no FFF load. Earlier 508 QWORDs + 3 QWORDs = 4088 bytes; +7 byte stages =4095 bytes.
Section headers = DllBase + signextended e_lfanew +24+SizeOfOptionalHeader. Native uses NT+14h WORD, unlike selector13 fixed NT+108h.

Decoded section preparation core: header stride40; DWORD+0C VirtualAddress, +10 SizeOfRawData, +24 Characteristics. Requires raw size nonzero and Characteristics sign clear (WRITE bit80000000 absent). Outputs base+RVA, rawsize, rawsize&~7, rawsize&7, previous checksum zeroextended or seed22EC23BABD3A5801 if previous=0. Returns AX0(skip)/1(<8)/2(>=8). Encoded pointer ABI; wrapper alternatives still require full proof.

Verified actual body104 entry: wrapper native calls ADC103/ADC2C1 target B66840, not marker candidate B667E0. Descriptor+0 encoded final out,+8 DWORD remainder,+16 seed,+40 aligned-byte offset; fifth argument source_out. Always outputs source+offset; mixes first0..2 bytes; returns AL1 if remainder<=2, AL0 otherwise after writing partial seed.
37-byte fixed response QWORD+0=zeroextended EDX checksum, QWORD+8=RDI processed-section count; +16..36 previously zeroed. Output descriptor XOR5F541C4869DBACB8; data+0,usedDWORD+8,capacityDWORD+C.
Width-critical INC EAX zeroextends before 64-bit LEA multiply37. Captured inner result1 => align16(37)=48 stack allocation; unbounded naive64 pseudocode evaluation is incorrect.
Conditional low-ESP adjustment retained. Normal-stack report append assumptions do not establish this alternate stack path.
